_comment: Cards that exist only for the flash-permission test (tests/unit/casting/test_cast_as_though_flash.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_barracuda` is Tidal Barracuda's first line alone -- any player may cast as though they had flash -- without the prohibition half, so the permission can be read on its own. `t_orrery` is the Vedalken Orrery / Leyline of Anticipation shape, the same permission scoped to its controller. `t_own_turn_orrery` carries a condition, so the wearing-off has something to wear off. `t_sorcery` is a plain sorcery with no flash of its own: the witness that the permission is doing the work.
